cat > programs/task-41373d05.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    edge = set(grid[0]) | set(grid[-1]) | {grid[r][0] for r in range(h)} | {grid[r][-1] for r in range(h)}
    inside = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg and v not in edge}
    if len(inside) != 1:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    ray = next(iter(inside))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    def shoot(r, c, dr, dc):
        rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
            if grid[rr][cc] == ray:
                out[rr][cc] = 4
                break
            if grid[rr][cc] != bg:
                break
            out[rr][cc] = ray
            rr += dr
            cc += dc
    def process_line(coords, horizontal):
        i = 0
        while i < len(coords):
            r, c = coords[i]
            color = grid[r][c]
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(coords) and grid[coords[j][0]][coords[j][1]] == color:
                j += 1
            if color != bg and j - i >= 2:
                mid = (i + j - 1) // 2
                r, c = coords[mid]
                if horizontal:
                    dr, dc = (1 if r == 0 else -1), 0
                else:
                    dr, dc = 0, (1 if c == 0 else -1)
                shoot(r, c, dr, dc)
            i = j
    process_line([(0,c) for c in range(w)], True)
    process_line([(h-1,c) for c in range(w)], True)
    process_line([(r,0) for r in range(h)], False)
    process_line([(r,w-1) for r in range(h)], False)
    return out
PY
